d.name: Company of Heroes - Legacy Edition
d.desc: Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines RTS by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. This legacy version also grants access to the latest version of COH, just called "Company of Heroes".
min: 2.0 Ghz Intel Pentium IV or equivalent or AMD Athlon XP or equivalent
DirectX 9.0c compatible 64MB video card with Pixel Shader 1.1 support or equivalent and latest manufacturer drivers
9 GB of uncompressed free hard drive space (We recommend having 1 gigabyte of free space after installation)
Broadband internet connection and latest drivers.
rec: 3.0 Ghz Intel Pentium IV or equivalent
256 MB NVIDIA GeForce 6800 series or better
d.blurb:
Company of Heroes is a World War II real-time strategy game from Relic Entertainment. The campaign follows American forces from the Normandy landings across France, with missions built around taking and holding key positions. You command squads instead of single soldiers, and units use cover, suppress enemies and level buildings as battles move through towns and countryside.

Resources come from capturing territory, which keeps fights moving across the map rather than turtling in one base. The game offers a single-player campaign and online multiplayer. It suits players who like tactical RTS games where positioning matters, and who want a grounded take on the war. This version also unlocks the updated release of the game.
